answer: The inlet is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the ember. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. The tundra of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, split across independent auditors, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities.
